state.mainGoal: Assess React issue 37655 double-suspension false hook-order warning, distinguish evidence from allegation, and propose a testable fix.

state.reasoning: The issue alleges React 19.2.8, two use() suspensions separated only by non-stateful hooks, then a later stateful hook causes a false warning; no comments/repro execution were retrieved. Current react/react ReactFiberHooks.js declares hookTypesDev and hookTypesUpdateIndexDev; mountHookTypesDev initializes or pushes, while updateHookTypesDev increments the index and compares. This directly supports an append/index asymmetry, but not the complete runtime replay trace. Unknown: exact 19.2.8 source/reproduction and all dispatcher transition constraints.
